title: The sea opens
framework: Exodus 14 — Salvation by faith, not work

panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Exodus 14**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Exodus 14 and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Salvation by faith, not work. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Baptism into Christ (1 Cor 10:1-2).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
